job.title: Junior Python Backend Developer (FastAPI / Django)
job.description: DataStream Analytics (Gurugram) is looking for a Junior Python Developer. You will develop asynchronous web APIs using FastAPI, interact with PostgreSQL using SQLAlchemy / asyncpg, write background tasks with Celery and Redis, and ensure code quality with pytest and ruff.

pool.text: Python 3.11+ & Asyncio: mastered async/await paradigms, typing hints, and Pydantic data schemas
FastAPI: built performant REST endpoints with automatic OpenAPI generation and dependency injection
SQLAlchemy 2.0 & Alembic: wrote async ORM models, migrations, and parameterized raw SQL queries
Celery & Redis: engineered asynchronous task workers for PDF report generation and email notifications
DocuSigner: async document signing service backend with audit trails and PDF watermarking
B.Tech CSE, Thapar University, Patiala, 2022–2026, CGPA 8.4/10
Pytest & Coverage: created fixtures and test suites verifying status codes and error responses
Figma design system: designed mobile onboarding screens
Backend Intern at CloudPulse (Gurugram, 4 months): migrated synchronous Flask routes to FastAPI
Docker & Docker Compose: orchestrated local development stack with app, Postgres, and Redis
Vue.js: built frontend calculator app for personal use
Ruff & Mypy: maintained strict linting and static type checking in CI workflow
